svg.title: About Aneesh Parveda
svg.desc: FPGA and SoC Designer. B.Tech ECE, Semester 5, Vasavi College of Engineering, Hyderabad. iHub-Data AI and ML training programme, 24 weeks, September 2025 to February 2026, Certificate of Competency. Focus: VLSI and SoC design, RISC-V, DSP and hardware acceleration, Robotics, Edge AI and TinyML.
